headline: Same Day Certificates, Different Fates: Beitou Hejing Sold Over Half at 89% Discount, Wenhua Zhizhu Signed 4% at 68% Discount
summary: Beitou Hejing sold over half its same-day certificates at an 89% discount, while Wenhua Zhizhu signed 4% of units at a 68% discount, according to reports on Beijing's property market.
why: Discount-driven sales at new Beijing projects signal weak demand in China's property market, which affects developers, banks and local government land revenue.

original_headline: 同日取证不同命：北投和璟89折去化过半，文华知筑68折网签4%
